records.title: AWS stack never applied and never deployed: 0 deploy-aws and 0 provision-database runs at HEAD
records.evidenceAtHead: GitHub API, queried 2026-10-13: actions/workflows/deploy-aws.yml/runs total_count=0 and provision-database.yml total_count=0. The only remote tag is still v1.0.0 (8d56db74). terraform-tests.yml is 'Terraform tests (offline)' (terraform init -backend=false, mocked providers). Its last run, 37265039179 on 5b45c168e (2026-10-05), succeeded and already contains every terraform/ commit up to HEAD. deploy-aws.yml is production-only: env block at lines 29-81 and `environment: production` at 399, 821 and 959. No staging deploy path exists. Since the audit, CI builds Dockerfile.optimized and boots it on an empty database with sign-in (the 'Production Image Boot' job), so the image path has some proof. That job has been red on every trunk run since a8fd98a23 (2026-10-12 17:27); see OPS-02. Still blocked by OPS-03: the state bucket name is still taken (re-probed 403, eu-west-1). Also blocked by OPS-02: the ci-verdict job in deploy-aws.yml (lines 94-145) refuses any SHA without a successful ci.yml, semgrep.yml and codeql.yml push run, and 0 of the last 1000 trunk ci.yml runs succeeded.
records.remaining: Everything. No real apply of bootstrap, staging or production has happened. The database has never been provisioned and no deploy or smoke test has run. There are no apply or deploy logs, and no second plan showing zero drift. Every AWS-side control is unproven in AWS: CloudFront-only ALB, KMS vault key, SES login codes, RDS TLS verify-full, the ECS boot contract and the GitHub OIDC roles.
records.severityRationale: The pilot is defined as one AWS production environment. None exists, and no deploy has ever executed, so the pilot cannot start. A customer date cannot be committed until a first apply and deploy succeed.
records.humanTestingNote: Testers will not see this on a local deployment. There is no AWS staging or production, so human testing has to run on a local or docker install (scripts/db/install-fresh.mjs plus the dev server). AWS-only behaviour stays untested by testers: CloudFront routing of /mcp, SES delivery of login codes, KMS-encrypted vault objects in S3, and the boot refusals that apply only to the ECS task. Note that HEAD itself cannot provision a fresh database (see OPS-02).
records.instructions:
1. Founder supplies the inputs: AWS account ID(s); confirmation of us-east-1 (hard-coded in deploy-aws.yml:29 and provision-database.yml env AWS_REGION); the domain and DNS control; an ACM certificate for the ALB (regional) and one for CloudFront (us-east-1); SES production access with DKIM/SPF on the sending domain; AI provider keys plus the AI_PROVIDER_PLACEMENT_APPROVALS JSON; a budget. Fill terraform/environments/production/terraform.tfvars from terraform.tfvars.example and never commit it.
2. Land OPS-03 (rename the state bucket) first. Bootstrap cannot be applied until it is done.
3. Run terraform -chdir=terraform/bootstrap init and apply in the real account. Save the full log.
4. Land OPS-02 until one trunk SHA has a successful ci.yml, semgrep.yml and codeql.yml push run. deploy-aws.yml ci-verdict (lines 94-145) refuses anything else, and the `test` job (lines 148-166) reruns npm run lint and npm test.
5. Production root: run terraform init with the OPS-03 backend config, then terraform plan -out tfplan with a placeholder image_tag. If the account already has a GitHub OIDC provider, set create_github_oidc_provider=false (terraform/environments/production/main.tf:79). Review the plan, then run terraform apply tfplan. The API service will stay unhealthy until the first deploy; that is expected.
6. Run terraform plan again and require 'No changes'. This proves that engine_version '15', auto_minor_version_upgrade and the boot contract do not drift. File both logs.
7. Point the DNS alias(es) at the cloudfront_domain output (production/main.tf:113).
8. From terraform output, set the repo secrets AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN, AWS_BUILD_ROLE_ARN (github_deploy_role_arn and github_build_role_arn, main.tf:149-153) and CLOUDFRONT_DISTRIBUTION_ID (main.tf:157). Create the GitHub environment `production` with required reviewers and a deployment tag policy of v*.
9. Fail first: dispatch deploy-aws.yml on a SHA whose CI is red. Confirm that job 'CI passed for this commit' fails with 'Refusing to deploy a commit whose CI did not pass', and file the run URL.
10. Dispatch provision-database.yml with confirm='provision production database' and file the run URL.
11. Tag the green SHA v<x.y.z>. Require build-push, migrate, deploy-api, deploy-frontend and smoke-test to be green, with /readyz returning 200 through CloudFront.
12. Run npm run pilot:verify-otp (scripts/ops/verify-otp-delivery.mjs) against a real inbox, then sign in through the CloudFront alias.
13. File the apply logs, plan-no-change log and run URLs under docs/evidence/D1/<date>-first-apply/.
records.acceptance:
- GitHub API shows deploy-aws.yml total_count >= 1, with a run that concludes success for every job, including smoke-test.
- provision-database.yml has one successful run.
- A deploy-aws dispatch on a red SHA was shown failing at ci-verdict before the green deploy.
- terraform plan after the apply reports no changes.
- curl https://<alias>/readyz returns 200.
- pilot:verify-otp delivers a code to a real inbox, and a person signs in.
- The logs are filed under docs/evidence/D1/.
records.dependencies: OPS-03 (open, state bucket); OPS-02 (open, green SHA required by ci-verdict); founder inputs (account, domain, ACM, SES, AI keys); OPS-08 and OPS-09 (worker_desired_count = 0 in the tfvars examples, and Dockerfile.optimized:172 now copies workers/artifact-compute; neither re-verified in this batch); OPS-11 launch config.

records.title: Canonical branch still red: 0 green in the last 1000 CI runs, HEAD cannot provision a fresh database, nothing gates landing (deploy-time CI gate added)
records.evidenceAtHead: GitHub API, 2026-10-13: the last 1000 ci.yml runs on concept2cure-v2 (2026-09-25T03:10 to 2026-10-13T16:34) are 993 failure, 7 queued or in progress, and 0 success. Run 38358525641 is on 9a59bc8f9 (HEAD^; HEAD 94b4f9238 only edits docs/work-orders/README.md). In it, Lint fails at 'Proof tier' (ci.yml:301-310, npm run test:proof-tier) and at 'every in-scope AnA tool reads from its register entry' (ci.yml:604-612). Test, Coverage (ratchet) and Integration Tests also fail. So do three provisioning jobs: Blank DB Provisioning ('Deploy migration succeeds on the provisioned database'), Production Boot Smoke ('Provision the schema from scratch') and Production Image Boot ('Provision the empty database with the provision image'). Build, Assemble Release Evidence and Release evidence gate are skipped. HEAD's own run, 38429984856, already fails the same two Lint steps. Reproduced locally at HEAD: npm run ci:step-presentation reports 'FAILED, 10 finding(s)', meaning 10 tools have no `present` block in server/services/ana/tool-authorization.register.json (answer_intelligence_question, assess_recorded_batch_poolability, assess_recorded_process_capability, assess_recorded_stability_trend, commit_intelligence_flow, compare_recorded_dissolution, estimate_recorded_shelf_life, list_cmc_registers, resume_intelligence_flow, start_intelligence_flow). There is also a fresh-database regression at HEAD. In db/migrations/20260813_knowledge_graph_tenant_keys.sql:146-156, the citation backfill reads knowledge_graph_nodes.organization_id before the loop that adds that column. The blank-DB, boot-smoke and image-boot jobs have been red on every trunk run from a8fd98a23 (after 15af6bc4b, 2026-10-12) and were green up to a2acf90b2. Tier 5's authenticated browser smoke and golden journey failed at HEAD (run 38429985184) and are green at 4c03bc548, after the post-HEAD commit 2ef129e54 added the column guard. Nothing gates landing: GET branches/concept2cure-v2 returns protected:false with required_status_checks contexts [], rules/branches returns [], and the only ruleset ('JMSMITH') has enforcement disabled. .husky/pre-push (707 lines) has no vitest, jest or npm test call. repo-health-baseline-refresh.yml:17-20,56-65 still commits a refreshed baseline to concept2cure-v2 after every push. One mitigation landed: deploy-aws.yml:94-145 adds a `ci-verdict` job that requires success of the ci.yml, semgrep.yml and codeql.yml push runs on the exact SHA. build-push (:260) and deploy-frontend (:950) need it, and tests/ci/deploy-refuses-unproven-sha.contract.test.ts pins it. A red SHA therefore can no longer be deployed by tag. CI latency: run 38358525641 was created at 06:45, Lint started at 12:08, and Test finished at 15:28 (about 8.7 h to verdict). The audit's named failing file tests/routes/export-governance-fail-closed.test.ts now passes locally (2/2), so the failure set has churned rather than been cleared.
records.remaining: Lint has 2 failing steps, plus Test, Coverage and Integration. HEAD cannot provision a fresh database (fixed only after HEAD, in 2ef129e54). No branch protection, ruleset or merge queue exists. Pre-push runs no tests. The bot auto-refresh of the repo-health baseline is still active. No deployable (green) SHA exists, so the release path is closed.
records.severityRationale: The deploy refuses every SHA (ci-verdict plus the in-workflow npm test), so no release can reach the pilot. At HEAD, a new environment cannot even be provisioned. A validated state cannot be claimed for GxP while trunk has had no green run for 18 days.
records.humanTestingNote: Symptom at HEAD 94b4f9238: setting up a NEW test environment fails at deploy-migrate with 'column n.organization_id does not exist' in db/migrations/20260813_knowledge_graph_tenant_keys.sql. CI's authenticated browser sign-in smoke and the WO-06 golden journey also fail at this SHA. Workaround: merge origin/concept2cure-v2 at or after 2ef129e54, where Tier 5 sign-in and the golden journey are green (4c03bc548, 28f7bd63b). Alternatively, test against a database provisioned before 15af6bc4b, since replays pass. Because trunk is never green, testers should record the exact SHA under test with every defect report.
records.instructions:
1. Bring the fresh-DB fix in by merging, never rebasing: git fetch origin && git merge origin/concept2cure-v2 (it must include 2ef129e54). Fail-first evidence already exists: CI run 38358525641 has a red 'Blank DB Provisioning + Deploy Migration'. Require that job, Production Boot Smoke and Production Image Boot to be green on the merged SHA.
2. Fix the Lint step at ci.yml:604-612. In server/services/ana/tool-authorization.register.json, add a `present` block, with a verb and a source taken from shared/ana/step-verbs.ts, to each of the 10 tools that npm run ci:step-presentation lists. Run npm run ci:step-presentation:selftest && npm run ci:step-presentation and require exit 0.
3. Fix the Lint step at ci.yml:301-310. Run npm run test:proof-tier (vitest over tests/schema-contract, tests/golden-journeys and tests/export-contract), then fix each failing spec at the source. Never loosen an assertion.
4. Fix the Test job. Enumerate the failing files from the uploaded test-results artifact of the latest trunk run (vitest.json and jest.json), or run npx vitest run --config vitest.config.ts <dir> one directory at a time. Fix the code, then re-run each file on its own.
5. Re-run Coverage (ratchet) and Integration Tests and fix whatever remains. Do not lower the coverage baseline to pass.
6. Stop the bot from rewriting the gate's baseline. Remove the commit-and-push step at .github/workflows/repo-health-baseline-refresh.yml:56-65; the workflow is a maintenance job, not a user capability. Baseline changes then go through a human commit that the Lint repo-health step checks.
7. Gating under Rule 0 is a founder decision; record it in docs/ and CLAUDE.md. A ruleset with required status checks would refuse every direct push, because a commit has no checks before it is pushed, so it is incompatible with Rule 0 unless a merge queue is adopted. The in-rule options are (a) and (b):
   (a) In .husky/pre-push, add a bounded test step: npx vitest related --run on the files changed versus @{u}, plus npm run test:proof-tier. Add a selftest that commits a deliberately failing test and shows pre-push refusing it.
   (b) A red-trunk freeze: a workflow_run workflow on CI for concept2cure-v2 that, on failure, sets a repository variable TRUNK_RED=sha. pre-push reads it through the GitHub API and refuses pushes whose message does not reference the fix.
8. Keep deploy-aws.yml ci-verdict (lines 94-145) and prove it fails first: dispatch deploy-aws.yml on a red SHA and file the refusal run URL.
9. Reduce CI queueing (see OPS-25) so a verdict lands within deploy-aws.yml CI_VERDICT_WAIT_MINUTES=90 (line 105). Run 38358525641 waited about 5 h for runners.
records.acceptance:
- At least 10 consecutive ci.yml push runs on concept2cure-v2 conclude success, with Build, Assemble Release Evidence and Release evidence gate executed, not skipped.
- Blank DB Provisioning, Production Boot Smoke, Production Image Boot and Tier 5 are green on trunk.
- npm run ci:step-presentation exits 0, and its selftest exits non-zero when one `present` block is removed.
- No github-actions[bot] commits land on concept2cure-v2 after the change (git log --author=github-actions --since=<date> is empty).
- A deliberately failing test is refused by pre-push (shown), and deploy-aws ci-verdict refuses a red SHA (run URL filed).
records.dependencies: Founder decision on the gating model versus Rule 0 (OPS-18); OPS-25 (CI capacity and latency); merge of 2ef129e54.

records.title: Terraform state bucket name c2c-terraform-state is still taken (eu-west-1) and still hard-coded in bootstrap and both backends
records.evidenceAtHead: terraform/environments/production/main.tf:19-23 and terraform/environments/staging/main.tf:19-23 still declare backend s3 { bucket = 'c2c-terraform-state', region = 'us-east-1', dynamodb_table = 'c2c-terraform-lock' }. terraform/bootstrap/variables.tf:6-9 still defaults state_bucket_name to 'c2c-terraform-state'. No commit in 92ccdba1..HEAD changes either the backend blocks or that default. Re-probed on 2026-10-13: curl https://c2c-terraform-state.s3.amazonaws.com/ returned HTTP 403 AccessDenied with x-amz-bucket-region: eu-west-1. The other planned global names (c2c-prod-part11-evidence, c2c-prod-frontend, c2c-prod-vault, c2c-stg-part11-evidence, c2c-stg-frontend, c2c-stg-vault) return 404 NoSuchBucket, so they are still free but carry no suffix (terraform/stack/main.tf:9-10, terraform/stack/vault_storage.tf:29) in a public repository.
records.remaining: Rename the state bucket (account-suffixed) in bootstrap and in both backends, with a guard. Optionally, account-suffix the evidence, frontend and vault bucket names before the first apply.
records.severityRationale: Bootstrap apply fails with BucketAlreadyExists, and terraform init in both roots fails (access denied, or a region mismatch if the bucket is the founder's). No AWS environment can be created until this is fixed. Trivial effort, but it hard-blocks OPS-01.
records.instructions:
1. Ask the founder whether the eu-west-1 bucket c2c-terraform-state is theirs. Default plan regardless: a new account-suffixed name, because reusing it forces an eu-west-1 backend for a us-east-1 stack.
2. terraform/bootstrap/main.tf: add data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {} and a local, state_bucket = coalesce(var.state_bucket_name, "c2c-tfstate-${data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id}-${var.region}"). Use local.state_bucket at line 22 (aws_s3_bucket.tfstate.bucket) and at lines 43 and 49 (KMS description and alias). terraform/bootstrap/variables.tf:6-10: change the default to null. The output at main.tf:118-119 already exposes the name.
3. In both roots (production/main.tf:20, staging/main.tf:20), delete the literal bucket line from backend "s3" and keep key, region and dynamodb_table, making it a partial backend configuration. Add terraform/environments/{production,staging}/backend.hcl.example containing bucket = "c2c-tfstate-<ACCOUNT_ID>-us-east-1". Once the account is known, commit the real backend.hcl; an account ID is not a secret.
4. In terraform/README.md, sections 1-3 (lines 24-50): change the init steps to terraform init -backend-config=backend.hcl, and get the name from terraform -chdir=terraform/bootstrap output -raw state_bucket.
5. Add scripts/ci/check-terraform-backend.mjs plus package.json scripts ci:terraform-backend and ci:terraform-backend:selftest, and run them in terraform-tests.yml. The check refuses any backend "s3" block in terraform/environments/* that carries a literal bucket, and refuses a bootstrap default other than null. Selftest (fail first): feed it git show 92ccdba1:terraform/environments/production/main.tf and require a refusal, then require HEAD to pass after steps 2-3.
6. Optional, and only before the first apply, because renaming a created bucket means recreating it: account-suffix local.evidence_bucket and local.frontend_bucket (stack/main.tf:9-10) and local.vault_bucket (vault_storage.tf:29). Replace deploy-aws.yml:80 FRONTEND_BUCKET: c2c-prod-frontend with ${{ vars.FRONTEND_BUCKET }}, set from the frontend_bucket output (stack/outputs.tf:86). Update terraform/modules/github-deploy-roles/tests/roles.tftest.hcl:36, and confirm that boot_contract.tftest.hcl:689 still excludes FRONTEND_BUCKET.
7. In the real account: terraform -chdir=terraform/bootstrap init/apply, then terraform init -backend-config=backend.hcl in each root. File the logs.
records.acceptance:
- The backend guard refuses the 92ccdba1 production main.tf (shown) and passes at the new HEAD.
- No file under terraform/ contains the string c2c-terraform-state.
- Bootstrap apply creates c2c-tfstate-<account>-us-east-1.
- terraform init succeeds in both roots against it.
- curl https://<new-name>.s3.amazonaws.com/ returns 403 with x-amz-bucket-region: us-east-1, meaning it is owned in the right region.
records.dependencies: Founder: AWS account ID, and an answer on the eu-west-1 bucket. Blocks OPS-01.

records.title: RDS engine now pinned to major version 15 with auto minor upgrades (creation blocker closed); gp3 and copy_tags_to_snapshot still unset
records.evidenceAtHead: terraform/environments/production/main.tf:55 and staging/main.tf:57 now set rds_engine_version = '15' (major only). terraform/stack/variables.tf:60-66 and terraform/modules/rds/variables.tf:6-14 validate the pattern ^[0-9]+$, so '15.4' is refused at plan. terraform/modules/rds/main.tf:21-23 sets engine_version = var.engine_version, auto_minor_version_upgrade = true and allow_major_version_upgrade = false. The parameter-group family is derived from the major at main.tf:80 ('postgres15'). The engine_version_actual output (modules/rds/outputs.tf:32-34) feeds the IQ record. Test: terraform/stack/tests/boot_contract.tftest.hcl:1066-1072, run 'refuses_a_pinned_rds_minor_version', expects '15.4' to fail validation. terraform-tests.yml run 37265039179 (5b45c168e, 2026-10-05) succeeded, and no terraform/ change has landed since. Still unset in aws_db_instance.this: storage_type (provider default gp2), copy_tags_to_snapshot and iam_database_authentication_enabled (grep of terraform/ finds none). Whether major 15 can be created is not verifiable from the repo. AWS lists PostgreSQL 15 in standard support until 2028-02-29, and a major-only pin cannot hit a retired minor.
records.remaining: Polish items from the finding's own fix list: an explicit storage_type = gp3 (the provider default is gp2), copy_tags_to_snapshot = true, and an optional iam_database_authentication_enabled. Real-AWS confirmation that 15.x creates and that a second plan shows no engine_version drift waits on OPS-01.
records.severityRationale: The P0 impact (CreateDBInstance failing on a retired 15.4, and minor-version drift) is closed in code and pinned by a plan-time validation and test. What remains is cost, performance and snapshot-tagging hygiene that does not block the pilot.
records.instructions:
1. In terraform/modules/rds/variables.tf, add variable "storage_type" { type = string, default = "gp3" } with validation contains(["gp3","io1","io2"], var.storage_type).
2. In terraform/modules/rds/main.tf, inside aws_db_instance.this after max_allocated_storage (line 25), add storage_type = var.storage_type and copy_tags_to_snapshot = true. Leave iam_database_authentication_enabled off unless the app adopts IAM auth tokens; enabling it unused adds nothing.
3. In terraform/stack/tests/boot_contract.tftest.hcl, next to run 'refuses_a_pinned_rds_minor_version' (line 1066), add a plan run that asserts module.rds.aws_db_instance.this.storage_type == "gp3" and copy_tags_to_snapshot == true. Fail first: run terraform test in terraform/stack before step 2 and confirm the new run fails, then apply step 2 and confirm it passes.
4. Land this before the first real apply (OPS-01). Changing gp2 to gp3 on a live instance triggers a storage-optimization period.
5. After the first apply, record terraform output engine_version_actual in the IQ record, and confirm that a second terraform plan shows no change to engine_version.
records.acceptance:
- terraform test in terraform/stack passes with the new assertions, and fails when storage_type is set to gp2 or copy_tags_to_snapshot is removed (shown).
- The first real apply creates PostgreSQL 15.x on gp3.
- A follow-up plan reports no changes.
